Offices listed in Palo Alto, New York, London and Cape Town with no stated primary HQ; no founding year published

description: Talent sourcing, recruiting and professional learning products sold to employers in every sector, offered to public agencies through the Carahsoft government distribution contract
notes: The exhibitor listing 'LinkedIn + Carahsoft' pairs a horizontal product company with its government reseller. Two readings are possible and the owner should pick: LinkedIn Talent Solutions as a horizontal product (scope_review, recorded here), or Carahsoft as the exhibiting entity, which is a distributor and would be a supplier. Carahsoft's own site describes it as a distributor and Master Aggregator, not a product company

description: Labor market and skills data, analytics software and consulting sold to state workforce agencies, colleges and private employers
notes: Flagged rather than decided because the site markets three co-equal segments, Education, Enterprise and Public Sector, so government is one buyer among many; the enterprise talent-strategy business is large. Formed from the Emsi and Burning Glass merger. Site says 'over 25 years' experience' but publishes no founding year or HQ address
